ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; the fluke surface is dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels with sparse, localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters, primarily representing splashing water or small scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Base surface is approximately 95% black. High-intensity white pixel clusters are concentrated at the distal tip of the left lobe (viewer's left), the trailing edge of the right lobe, and scattered as fine speckling across the central-lower ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep symmetrical V-shaped depression; internal angle estimated at approximately 60 degrees; significant depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays high-amplitude, irregular serrations with a prominent rectangular indentation near the midpoint. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits lower-amplitude, more frequent peaks creating a jagged saw-tooth appearance.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex sweep along the leading edge (partially submerged); trailing edge curves upward and outward towards distal tips with localized concave variations between serration peaks.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white textured cluster on the far left distal tip, indicating significant barnacle colonization. Numerous small circular white points scattered across the lower-central fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions (white rake marks) are visible on the left lobe; a single diagonal linear mark is visible on the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregular bulbous protrusion/calcification at the distal tip of the left lobe. Small semi-circular notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Overall pigmentation is exceptionally dark (Type 1 classification) with rare, high-contrast linear white markings and heavy barnacle accretion localized strictly to the left fluke tip.
